title: Cubixon Core
description: A unique vanilla-style resource pack that combines clean 2D textures with light 3D block elements and custom animated items.
body:
**Cubixion Core – Vanilla-Like Resource Pack (1.21.8, No Optifine or Iris required)**


Cubixion Core is a lightweight, vanilla-style resource pack for Minecraft 1.21.8 that blends 2D simplicity with select 3D enhancements, delivering a clean, faithful experience with a fresh twist.

**This pack includes:**

Redesigned 2D textures faithful to Minecraft's original look

Some blocks enhanced in 3D, where possible without Optifine

Custom item animations for specific tools and weapons

**All this stuff fully compatible with vanilla Minecraft — no mods or Optifine required**

Cubixion Core is ideal for players who want a fresh style without losing the familiar feeling of Minecraft. It stays true to the game's identity while adding subtle effects and polish that make it stand out.

**Updates**
This pack is currently in modular beta — new blocks and features are added over time in themed updates (e.g. terrain, decoration, etc.).

**Stay tuned for:**

Cubixon Prime will add all item and more blocks in 3D
